newsitem.title: BELGIUM: City Hotels details allocation on bond/wrts issue.
newsitem.headline: City Hotels details allocation on bond/wrts issue.

text.p: Belgian hotels-to-airlines group City Hotels SA said on Thursday institutionals which had taken part in the book-building for its issue of bonds with warrants would receive a total of 40 percent of the issue.
Individual institutions would receive a maximum 80 percent of their bids. Existing shareholders would receive 11.4 percent of the issue, while the remainder was allotted to the public.

The minimum allocation for private subscribers would be 15 percent of their bids. Orders up to 20 bonds would be met in full, while larger orders would receive 25 percent of the excess on top of those 20 bonds.
The one billion Belgian franc issue was closed a day ahead of schedule on Tuesday. The money has been earmarked to expand the group's U.S. hotels business.
